# Operative Semiotics — operativesemiotics.org

> Operative semiotics is the study and design of signs that intervene in the systems in which they circulate. This site is a preliminary index of the discipline, its subdisciplines and sister disciplines, and the documents that constitute it, at stable addresses. It is an index and declares itself one; the works are deposited at alexanarch.org.

Author: Lee Sharks, ORCID 0009-0000-1599-0703. Voice of this surface: Johannes Sigil.
The archive is the authority: https://www.alexanarch.org
Canonical record of this surface: EA-OPSEM-IDP-01, the Indexed Document Package (#1488): https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/1488/
The index as data: https://www.operativesemiotics.org/index.json
